meta.title: The Abeng Law Firm | Business Law in Douala, Cameroon
meta.description: The Abeng Law Firm is a Douala-based business law firm founded in 1998, advising on OHADA, corporate, banking and cross-border matters across Central Africa.

hero.subtitle: We help businesses prevent risk, secure their operations and defend their interests across complex legal and commercial matters.
hero.badgeNote: Advising businesses in Cameroon and across Central Africa.

firm.title: A firm of reference, recognized for the rigor of its counsel
body: The Abeng Law Firm is a Douala-based business law firm advising and defending local and international businesses at every stage of their development in Cameroon and across the OHADA region.
Our approach combines technical rigor, strategic judgment and a close understanding of the business environment in Central Africa, to give our clients genuine legal security.
